name: dash-board
description: DASH — Daily Agenda & Schedule Hub. A lightweight personal schedule dashboard.

scripts.app:assets: node scripts/make-app-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/make-app-assets.mjs --launcher
scripts.app:debug: npm run app:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.app:release: npm run app:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
